question: Which of the following countries had the highest population density, according to World Bank in the year 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monaco.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The European city-state of **Monaco** is the most densely populated country with a population density of **26,523** people per sq. km (68,696/sq mile), and its population only numbers in thousands.
 
• Population density is calculated as population divided by total land area.
 
• The Chinese territory of **Macau** has the world's 2nd highest population density at 22,020/km². 
 
• Only these two have over 10,000 population per square kilometer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• World Bank is headquartered in Washington D.C.
 
• The President of World Bank is David Malpass.
 
• Monaco currency is Euro.​
